en: Second barrel. Twin stream of tracer rounds.
Continuous beam that burns whatever it touches.
2 unguided rockets every second from the wing pylons.
No serials, no questions. Salvage only.
3-way spread. Rounds burst into fragments on hit.
Heavy slug that pierces everything in its path. Fires faster in Thresher form.
Targets keep burning after the beam leaves them.
Splits into 3 angled beams. Thresher form merges them into one.
Missiles split into 4 small homing submunitions.
Big slow bombs with a wide blast. Double damage to ground targets.
+30% speed. Thresher form moves at 70% speed, not 55%.
Blade-edged wings cut any aircraft you touch. Ramming no longer hurts you.
Double-tap a direction (or press RB) to dash. You can't be hit mid-dash.
25 Plating: a shield that soaks hits and recharges after 3 seconds.
Every hit you take blasts a ring of shrapnel outward.
Slowly restores Armor while it's below half.
Keep your assimilated weapon module through one extra sector.
